_comment_fixture: Comprehensive NINA 'Advanced Sequencer' export covering the happy-path constructs most users will hit: target header with InputCoordinates, switch-filter, autofocus, a loop-container body driven by LoopCondition.Iterations, take-exposure with Filter/Gain/Offset/Binning, dither between exposures, and a MeridianFlipTrigger watchdog. All $type discriminators use NINA's Newtonsoft.Json format (FullName, AssemblyName) — same shape as the canonical fixture but exercising more node types end-to-end.
Name: Advanced — NGC 7635 LRGB

Items._comment_target: DeepSkyObjectContainer is NINA's 'Target' wrapper. The parser maps it to CanonicalKind.targetHeader and reads TargetName + InputCoordinates.RAHours/Dec.
Items.Name: NGC 7635 Bubble Nebula

Conditions._comment_loop_condition: LoopCondition.Iterations sits inside Conditions[] on the parent container — the parser folds this into the parent so the mapper can produce LoopNode(count=10). Real NINA exports place this here, not on the LoopContainer itself.

Triggers._comment_trigger: Triggers[] are appended in-line to the container body as additional children (e.g. the meridian flip watchdog runs alongside the imaging loop).
Triggers.Name: Meridian Flip Watchdog

Items._comment_slew: SlewScopeToCoordinates: bare slew to target without plate-solve. Less common than Center but covered by the classify table.
Items.Name: Slew to Target

Items._comment_center: Center after slew uses plate solve to lock pointing. NINA's Center node carries the target Coordinates verbatim.
Items.Name: Center Target

Items._comment_autofocus: RunAutofocus is parameterless on NINA's side — every setting comes from the profile.
Items.Name: Autofocus Once

Items._comment_start_guiding: StartGuiding instructs NINA to engage PHD2 — the Skotiq mapper produces a StartGuidingNode.
Items.Name: Start Guiding

Items._comment_filter: SwitchFilter with a FilterInfo payload. Real NINA exports use the '_name' key (Newtonsoft field-name remap) and an integer Position.
Items.Name: Switch to Ha

Items._comment_loop: Inner LoopContainer holds the per-filter exposure plan. Its Conditions[].Iterations is the count surfaced on the canonical loop node.
Items.Name: Ha Light Frames

Items._comment_dither: Dither between exposures. NINA stores the pixel offset on the Dither node directly.
Items.Name: Dither

Items._comment_delay: Delay/Wait — short pause between filter banks. NINA uses Seconds (or Duration on older builds).
Items.Name: Settle After Flip
